verses.text: Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim. He said, "Go and look over the land, especially Jericho." So they went and came to the house of a prostitute named Rahab, and they stayed there.
Someone told the king of Jericho, "Look, some men of Israel came here tonight to spy out the land."
So the king of Jericho sent a message to Rahab: "Bring out the men who came into your house. They have come to spy out the whole land."
But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them. She said, "Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know where they were from.
When it was getting dark, at the time to shut the city gate, the men left. I do not know where they went. Chase after them quickly. You may catch them."
But she had taken them up to the roof and hidden them under the stalks of flax she had laid out there.
So the king's men chased them along the road to the river crossings of the Jordan. As soon as they had gone out, the gate was shut.
Before the spies lay down to sleep, Rahab went up to them on the roof.
She said to them, "I know that the LORD has given you this land. We are terrified of you, and everyone who lives here is melting with fear because of you.

We have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red Sea for you when you came out of Egypt. We heard what you did to Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites east of the Jordan, whom you completely destroyed.
When we heard it, our hearts melted, and everyone lost courage because of you. For the LORD your God is God in heaven above and on the earth below.
So now, please promise me by the LORD that you will be kind to my family, because I have been kind to you. Give me a sure sign
that you will spare the lives of my father, my mother, my brothers, my sisters and all who belong to them. Save us from death."
The men said to her, "Our lives for yours! If you do not tell anyone what we are doing, we will be kind and faithful to you when the LORD gives us the land."
So she let them down by a rope through the window, because her house was built into the city wall, and she lived on the wall.
She said to them, "Go to the hills so the men chasing you will not find you. Hide there for three days until they come back. Then you can go on your way."
The men said to her, "We will be free from this promise you made us swear,
unless, when we come into the land, you tie this red cord in the window you let us down through. Bring your father, your mother, your brothers and all your family into your house.
If anyone goes out of your house into the street, their death will be their own fault, and we will not be to blame. But if anyone in the house with you is harmed, we will be to blame.
But if you tell anyone what we are doing, we will be free from the promise you made us swear."
She said, "Let it be as you say." She sent them away, and they left. Then she tied the red cord in the window.
They went into the hills and stayed there three days, until the men chasing them had gone back. The chasers searched all along the road but did not find them.
Then the two men came down from the hills, crossed the river and came to Joshua son of Nun. They told him everything that had happened to them.
They said to Joshua, "The LORD has surely given the whole land into our hands. Everyone who lives there is melting with fear because of us."
